VREAndroids.AndroidGeneDef.label: reactive armor
VREAndroids.AndroidGeneDef.description: Reactive armor that damages attackers in melee combat (reflects 100% of melee damage back to attackers, but the android also takes damage). Warning: in case of critical damage, the android may explode!

customEffectDescriptions.li: Melee attacks on the android damage both the attacker and the android
